program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const mass = inputs.mass; const t = time; const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const height = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const acceleration = -gravity; const force = mass * gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); let motionState = "Rising"; if (t < 0.001) motionState = "Ready to toss"; else if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) < 0.05) motionState = "At the top"; else if (t > apexTime && height > 0) motionState = "Falling"; else if (height <= 0 && t > 0) motionState = "Back at height 0"; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ id: "lane.motion", x: 20, y: 30, w: 280, h: 360, title: "The Motion", state: motionState })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.y", { x: 60, y: 350, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); const ballY = 350 - (height / 2.2) * 260; objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", 140, ballY, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: 160, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: 185, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(205, ballY - 25, [`v: ${velocity.toFixed(2)} m/s`, `a: ${acceleration.toFixed(2)} m/s^2`, `F: ${force.toFixed(1)} N`], { id: "callout.toss" })); const points = []; const count = 20; for (let i = 0; i <= count; i++) { const st = (i / count) * 1.6666666666666667; const sv = launchSpeed - gravity * st; points.push({ x: st, y: sv }); } objects.push(sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 330, y: 30, w: 290, h: 220, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.6666666666666667, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: points.filter(p => p.x <= t) }] })); objects.push(sdk.text("plot.vt.note", 330, 270, "Slope a = -g", { role: "neutral" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, mass, apexTime, apexHeight, height, velocity, acceleration, force } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration and force remain active.
manifest.description: A ball is tossed vertically. At the apex, velocity momentarily vanishes while acceleration due to gravity remains constant.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings near the top.
